title: Driver Seva
sub: Govt work done for you — free for members

bt.title: Border Tax
bt.periodEnd: {mode} — valid till the period ends (date set by the govt portal)
bt.declare: I confirm these vehicle details are correct and accept the govt portal's declaration.
bt.freeNote: Free for members — you pay only the govt tax, on the official payment page.
bt.historyEmpty: Your border tax filings will show here.

filling.s: Filling the govt portal for you

awaiting_captcha.s: Type the code shown to continue

handed_off.s: Paid? Get your receipt from the official site

fail.captcha_timeout: You didn't type the code in time. Please file again.
fail.captcha_wrong: The code was wrong too many times. Please file again.
fail.portal_error: The govt portal had a problem. Try again in a few minutes.
fail.worker_restart: The govt portal had a problem. Try again in a few minutes.
fail.vehicle_pending: This vehicle has an unfinished payment on the govt portal. Wait about 30 minutes, then file again.
fail.already_paid: Tax is already paid for this time.
fail.road_tax_expired: Your vehicle's road tax has expired. Renew it first.
fail.no_tax_mode: The portal has no tax option for this vehicle at this border.
fail.no_handoff: The portal didn't open the bank page. Please try again.
fail.pucc_expired: Your vehicle's pollution certificate (PUC) has expired. Renew it, then file again.
fail.fitness_expired: Your vehicle's fitness certificate has expired. Renew it, then file again.
fail.no_qr: The govt payment page didn't show a UPI QR. Please try again.
fail.payment_failed: The payment didn't go through. If money was debited, contact support.
fail.payment_timeout: No payment in time. If you paid, contact support — don't pay again.
fail.payment_unknown: We lost the payment page. If you paid, contact support — don't pay again.

live.captchaSub: Our reader couldn't read this one. Type exactly what you see, including # or @.
live.closedSub: The payment link lasts about 5 minutes. If you didn't pay, the portal holds this vehicle for about 30 minutes — file again after that.

gate.title: Seva is for members
gate.sub: Border tax filing is free with EaseCab membership (₹149/month).

errors.vehicleBusy: This vehicle already has a filing in progress — see History.
errors.rateLimited: Too many filings. Try again in an hour.
errors.busy: Govt site is busy. Try again in {time}

prep.title: Preparing your border tax payment
prep.keepOpenS: Don't close or leave this screen. Your payment details will appear here automatically.
prep.queued: Starting soon — the govt site allows one lookup every 2 minutes
prep.startsIn: Starting in {time} — the govt site allows one lookup every 2 minutes

pay.title: Payment Details
pay.note: Opens the official govt payment page in a new tab. The link works for about 5 minutes. If a govt treasury page opens first, tap Continue there. EaseCab charges nothing.

bt.latestFee: Latest fee at this border: {amount} for {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ({date})

qr.title: Pay Border Tax
qr.scan: Or scan this QR from another phone with any UPI app.
qr.wait: Keep this screen open after paying — we'll fetch your govt receipt here.
qr.noReceipt: Paid, but the govt receipt didn't load. Contact support and we'll get it for you.
qr.saveHint: Save it to your phone now — we delete it from EaseCab on {date}, {time}.
qr.receiptGone: Receipt deleted from EaseCab 24 hours after the tax validity ended. Use the copy saved on your phone.
qr.gettingReceipt: Paid. Getting your receipt from the govt site…

unlock.error: Couldn't start. Try again in a minute.
unlock.queued: Clearing the lock on the govt portal now…
unlock.waiting: The portal frees this vehicle at {time}. We will clear it then.
unlock.cleared: Lock cleared. You can file again now.
unlock.paid: The earlier payment went through. Receipt no. {no}
unlock.failed: We couldn't clear the lock. Please contact support.
